items.title: Take a short walk after meals
items.text: Your sugar rose about 14.9 mg/dL less after meals when you walked. Aim for 10 to 20 minutes after dinner, where the program saw the biggest gain (18.3 mg/dL). A check in real adults (CGMacros) pointed the same way, at about a fifth of the program's size, but it is not proven there yet.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: When you had dinner at 8 pm or later, your sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more than after earlier dinners. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see a difference in your sugar levels.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 9.4 hours, which is a good start. Adding more hours to your overnight fast may be helpful, as 33.3% of nights reached 13 hours.
